scope.module: scripts/proc_dso_observation.py (diagnostic tool; not registered with CTest/Make/CI)
scope.product_callers_of_verify_file_object: none in this repository (re-verified by full-tree search before and after)

F-02_read_proc_stream.defect: time budget was checked only before each read; a real zero-byte EOF returned after the budget was still classified COMPLETE/EOF
contract_after: budgets unchanged (2 MiB bytes, 1024 attempts, 0.25 s, 65536 chunk); injected read/clock preserved
one monotonic sample after every successful read drives that step's decision and elapsed_seconds
same-read priority SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED > TIME_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED > EOF COMPLETE; exact-equal elapsed still completes (strict >)
late zero-byte EOF: INCOMPLETE/TIME_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with eof_observed=true, in-budget data and real counts kept; maps_eof_complete/evidence_complete derive only from COMPLETE
EINTR/EAGAIN/permission/disappearance/OSError mappings, attempt counting and ReadError chaining unchanged

F-03_verify_file_object.defect: os.stat then a second path open mixed two file objects: actual identity from the old stat, hash from the newly opened object; no type precheck, no fd identity, no post-read rechecks
contract_after: same name/signature; max_bytes default 1 GiB unchanged, validated as a positive non-bool integer

flow: lstat type precheck -> single read-only os.open (O_CLOEXEC/O_NONBLOCK/O_NOFOLLOW) -> fstat type/identity alignment -> same-fd chunked hash, requests capped at min(1 MiB, remaining+1), rejected on the really observed (limit+1)-th byte -> real zero-byte EOF -> fd re-fstat -> final pathname lstat -> compare device/inode/bytes/sha256
fstat/path comparisons cover device, inode, type, size, mtime_ns, ctime_ns; actual bytes are the really read byte count and must equal the stable size
success domain: regular non-symlink files; directory/FIFO/symlink and post-open type changes rejected without opening a FIFO
EXCEEDS_HASH_BUDGET kept, stage preflight_size vs read_limit_plus_one distinguishes the two byte-budget rejections; incomplete observations emit no actual hash field

bounded EINTR retries (DEFAULT_MAX_READ_ATTEMPTS) then structured EINTR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; other I/O errors propagate and never become matches=true; the single fd is closed on every return/reject/raise
documented limit: precheck/fd-restat/final-lstat are three separate samples, not an atomic filesystem snapshot; policy does not apply to the /proc/PID/exe magic link in RealProcIO.exe_identity
